```py
# src/bloque1/network.py
import copy
import logging
import threading
import traceback as _traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Iterable, Tuple

from .models import NodeRecord, ArcRecord, PrimeLogisticsError, ERROR_CATALOG
from .validators import NetworkValidator, ValidationResult

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class NetworkIndexer:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._nodes: Dict[str, NodeRecord] = {}
        self._arcs: Dict[str, ArcRecord] = {}
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

    def get_all_node_ids(self) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
        with self._lock:
            return tuple(self._nodes.keys())

    def iter_nodes(self) -> Iterable[NodeRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            return list(self._nodes.values())

    def iter_arcs(self) -> Iterable[ArcRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            return list(self._arcs.values())

    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            return {
                "nodes": {k: v.to_dict() for k, v in self._nodes.items()},
                "arcs": {k: v.to_dict() for k, v in self._arcs.items()},
            }

    def clear_indexer(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._nodes.clear()
            self._arcs.clear()

    def exists_node(self, node_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return node_id in self._nodes

    def exists_arc(self, arc_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return arc_id in self._arcs

    def exists(self, entity_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return (entity_id in self._nodes) or (entity_id in self._arcs)

    def get_node(self, node_id: str) -> Optional[NodeRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._nodes.get(node_id)

    def get_arc(self, arc_id: str) -> Optional[ArcRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._arcs.get(arc_id)

    def register_node(self, node: NodeRecord) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            existing = self._nodes.get(node.id)
            if existing:
                ev = existing.metadata.version if existing.metadata else None
                nv = node.metadata.version if node.metadata else None
                if ev is not None and nv is not None and ev == nv:
                    logger.info("Node %s ya registrado con misma versión %s; ignorando", node.id, ev)
                    return
                logger.warning("Actualizando nodo %s: %s -> %s", node.id, ev, nv)
            self._nodes[node.id] = node
            logger.debug("Node registrado: %s", node.id)

    def register_arc(self, arc: ArcRecord) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            existing = self._arcs.get(arc.id)
            if existing:
                ev = existing.metadata.version if existing.metadata else None
                nv = arc.metadata.version if arc.metadata else None
                if ev is not None and nv is not None and ev == nv:
                    logger.info("Arc %s ya registrado con misma versión %s; ignorando", arc.id, ev)
                    return
                logger.warning("Actualizando arco %s: %s -> %s", arc.id, ev, nv)
            self._arcs[arc.id] = arc
            logger.debug("Arc registrado: %s", arc.id)

    @property
    def node_count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._nodes)

    @property
    def arc_count(self) -> int:
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._arcs)


class Ingestor:
    def __init__(self, indexer: NetworkIndexer) -> None:
        self.indexer = indexer
        self._errors_lock = threading.RLock()
        self._errors: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def _log_errors(self, result: ValidationResult, context: str) -> None:
        for err in result.errors:
            e = copy.deepcopy(err)
            e["context"] = context
            e["timestamp"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            with self._errors_lock:
                self._errors.append(e)
            logger.debug("Validation error logged: %s", e)

    def _add_system_error(self, msg: str, code: str, context: Optional[str] = None, include_traceback: bool = False) -> None:
        definition = ERROR_CATALOG.get(code)
        entry: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "code": code,
            "message": msg,
            "severity": getattr(definition, "severity", "CRITICAL") if definition else "CRITICAL",
            "context": context,
            "suggested_fix": getattr(definition, "suggested_fix", "") if definition else "",
            "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        }
        if include_traceback:
            entry["traceback"] = _traceback.format_exc()
        with self._errors_lock:
            self._errors.append(entry)
        logger.error("System error: %s", entry)

    def get_errors(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        with self._errors_lock:
            return list(self._errors)

    def clear_errors(self) -> None:
        with self._errors_lock:
            self._errors.clear()

    def load_node(self, raw_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(raw_data, dict):
            self._add_system_error("raw_data debe ser dict", "ERR_SYS_001", context="load_node")
            return False

        id_val = raw_data.get("id")
        if id_val is None:
            self._add_system_error("id ausente en raw_data", "ERR_ID_002", context="load_node")
            return False

        id_res = NetworkValidator.validate_id(id_val, kind="NODE")
        if not id_res.ok:
            self._log_errors(id_res, context=f"Node {id_val}")
            return False

        geo_res = NetworkValidator.validate_coordinate(raw_data.get("lat"), raw_data.get("lon"))
        if not geo_res.ok:
            self._log_errors(geo_res, context=f"Node {id_val}")
            return False

        try:
            node = NodeRecord.from_dict(raw_data)
            if node is None:
                self._add_system_error(f"Node {id_val} instanciado como None", "ERR_MODEL_INIT", context=f"Node {id_val}")
                return False
            self.indexer.register_node(node)
            logger.info("Node cargado: %s", node.id)
            return True

        except PrimeLogisticsError as ple:
            code = getattr(ple, "error_code", "ERR_MODEL_INIT")
            self._add_system_error(str(ple), code, context=f"Node {id_val}")
            return False
        except Exception as e:
            self._add_system_error(f"Error instanciando Node {id_val}: {e}", "ERR_MODEL_INIT", context=f"Node {id_val}", include_traceback=True)
            logger.exception("Unexpected error instantiating Node %s", id_val)
            return False

    def load_arc(self, raw_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(raw_data, dict):
            self._add_system_error("raw_data debe ser dict", "ERR_SYS_001", context="load_arc")
            return False

        id_val = raw_data.get("id")
        if id_val is None:
            self._add_system_error("id ausente en raw_data", "ERR_ID_002", context="load_arc")
            return False

        id_res = NetworkValidator.validate_id(id_val, kind="ARC")
        if not id_res.ok:
            self._log_errors(id_res, context=f"Arc {id_val}")
            return False

        origin = raw_data.get("origin")
        destination = raw_data.get("destination")
        ref_res = NetworkValidator.validate_arc_references(origin, destination, self.indexer)
        if not ref_res.ok:
            self._log_errors(ref_res, context=f"Arc {id_val}")
            return False

        if "cost_profile" in raw_data:
            c_res = NetworkValidator.validate_cost_profile(raw_data.get("cost_profile"))
            if not c_res.ok:
                self._log_errors(c_res, context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                return False

        if "speed_profile" in raw_data:
            s_res = NetworkValidator.validate_speed_profile(raw_data.get("speed_profile"))
            if not s_res.ok:
                self._log_errors(s_res, context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                return False

        if "windows" in raw_data:
            windows = raw_data.get("windows")
            if not isinstance(windows, list):
                self._add_system_error("windows debe ser lista", "ERR_TIME_004", context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                return False
            for i, w in enumerate(windows):
                w_res = NetworkValidator.validate_window(w.get("start"), w.get("end"))
                if not w_res.ok:
                    self._log_errors(w_res, context=f"Arc {id_val} windows[{i}]")
                    return False

        try:
            arc = ArcRecord.from_dict(raw_data)
            if arc is None:
                self._add_system_error(f"Arc {id_val} instanciado como None", "ERR_MODEL_INIT", context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                return False

            md = getattr(arc, "metadata", None)
            mode = None
            station_origin = None
            station_dest = None
            cap_val = None
            cap_unit = None

            if isinstance(md, dict):
                mode = md.get("mode") or md.get("transport_type") or md.get("transport_mode")
                cap_val = md.get("capacity", None)
                cap_unit = md.get("capacity_unit", None)
            else:
                extras = getattr(md, "extras", None)
                if isinstance(extras, dict):
                    mode = extras.get("mode") or extras.get("transport_type") or extras.get("transport_mode")
                    cap_val = extras.get("capacity", None)
                    cap_unit = extras.get("capacity_unit", None)
                else:
                    mode = getattr(md, "mode", None)
                    cap_val = getattr(md, "capacity", None)
                    cap_unit = getattr(md, "capacity_unit", None)

            origin_node = self.indexer.get_node(origin)
            dest_node = self.indexer.get_node(destination)
            if origin_node:
                try:
                    o_md = getattr(origin_node, "metadata", None)
                    if isinstance(o_md, dict):
                        station_origin = o_md.get("station_type")
                    else:
                        o_ex = getattr(o_md, "extras", None)
                        if isinstance(o_ex, dict):
                            station_origin = o_ex.get("station_type")
                        else:
                            station_origin = getattr(o_md, "station_type", None)
                except Exception:
                    station_origin = None
            if dest_node:
                try:
                    d_md = getattr(dest_node, "metadata", None)
                    if isinstance(d_md, dict):
                        station_dest = d_md.get("station_type")
                    else:
                        d_ex = getattr(d_md, "extras", None)
                        if isinstance(d_ex, dict):
                            station_dest = d_ex.get("station_type")
                        else:
                            station_dest = getattr(d_md, "station_type", None)
                except Exception:
                    station_dest = None

            if mode:
                from .config import MODE_ALLOWED_STATION_TYPES
                mode_key = str(mode).strip().lower()
                allowed = MODE_ALLOWED_STATION_TYPES.get(mode_key, MODE_ALLOWED_STATION_TYPES.get("default", ()))
                def _is_allowed(st):
                    if st is None:
                        return False
                    return str(st).strip().lower() in {a.lower() for a in allowed}
                if not _is_allowed(station_origin) or not _is_allowed(station_dest):
                    self._add_system_error(
                        f"Arc {id_val} modo '{mode}' incompatible con estaciones: origin='{station_origin}' dest='{station_dest}'",
                        "ERR_MODE_STATION_INCOMPAT",
                        context=f"Arc {id_val}"
                    )
                    return False

            if cap_val is not None:
                try:
                    cap_f = float(cap_val)
                except Exception:
                    self._add_system_error(f"Arc {id_val} capacity inválida: {cap_val}", "ERR_CAP_INVALID", context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                    return False

                if cap_f < 0:
                    self._add_system_error(f"Arc {id_val} tiene capacity negativa: {cap_f}", "ERR_CAP_NEG", context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                    return False

                from .config import MAX_CAPACITY
                if cap_f > MAX_CAPACITY:
                    self._add_system_error(
                        f"Arc {id_val} capacity {cap_f} excede MAX_CAPACITY global {MAX_CAPACITY}",
                        "ERR_CAP_TOO_LARGE",
                        context=f"Arc {id_val}"
                    )
                    return False

            self.indexer.register_arc(arc)

            if cap_val is not None and mode:
                try:
                    cap_f = float(cap_val)
                    from .config import MODE_MAX_CAPACITY, UNIT_CONVERSIONS_TO_TON
                    if cap_unit:
                        conv = UNIT_CONVERSIONS_TO_TON.get(str(cap_unit).lower())
                        if conv is not None:
                            cap_f = cap_f * float(conv)
                    mode_key = str(mode).strip().lower()
                    threshold = MODE_MAX_CAPACITY.get(mode_key, MODE_MAX_CAPACITY.get("default"))
                    if cap_f > threshold:
                        msg = f"Arc {id_val} capacity {cap_f} t excede umbral por modo {mode_key} ({threshold} t); se clampa en export_matrices"
                        self._add_system_error(msg, "WARN_CAP_EXCEEDS_MODE", context=f"Arc {id_val}")
                        logger.warning(msg)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            logger.info("Arc cargado: %s", arc.id)
            return True

        except PrimeLogisticsError as ple:
            code = getattr(ple, "error_code", "ERR_MODEL_INIT")
            self._add_system_error(str(ple), code, context=f"Arc {id_val}")
            return False
        except Exception as e:
            self._add_system_error(f"Error instanciando Arc {id_val}: {e}", "ERR_MODEL_INIT", context=f"Arc {id_val}", include_traceback=True)
            logger.exception("Unexpected error instantiating Arc %s", id_val)
            return False

    def load_nodes(self, rows: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Tuple[int, int, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
        success = 0
        failed = 0
        failed_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in rows:
            if self.load_node(row):
                success += 1
            else:
                failed += 1
                failed_rows.append(row)
        logger.info("Batch nodes processed: success=%d failed=%d", success, failed)
        return success, failed, failed_rows

    def load_arcs(self, rows: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Tuple[int, int, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
        success = 0
        failed = 0
        failed_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in rows:
            if self.load_arc(row):
                success += 1
            else:
                failed += 1
                failed_rows.append(row)
        logger.info("Batch arcs processed: success=%d failed=%d", success, failed)
        return success, failed, failed_rows

    def get_validation_report(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        with self._errors_lock:
            return {
                "node_count": self.indexer.node_count,
                "arc_count": self.indexer.arc_count,
                "errors": list(self._errors),
                "error_count": len(self._errors),
                "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            }
```

```py
import logging
from typing import Dict, List, Any
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

# Intentamos importar configuraciones, si no existen, el sistema usa defaults internos
try:
    from .config import (
        MODE_MAX_CAPACITY,
        MODE_AVG_SPEED_KMH,
        TRUCK_ROUTE_MULTIPLIER,
        UNIT_CONVERSIONS_TO_TON
    )
except ImportError:
    # SAFE DEFAULTS (Rigor de supervivencia)
    MODE_MAX_CAPACITY = {"default": 1e7, "truck": 45.0}
    MODE_AVG_SPEED_KMH = {"default": 60.0, "truck": 70.0}
    TRUCK_ROUTE_MULTIPLIER = {"default": 0.9, "highway": 1.0}
    UNIT_CONVERSIONS_TO_TON = {"kg": 0.001, "ton": 1.0, "lb": 0.00045}

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
EARTH_RADIUS_KM = 6371.0

def vectorized_haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    """Calcula distancia entre arrays de coordenadas en km."""
    p1, p2 = np.radians(lat1), np.radians(lat2)
    dphi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlam = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = np.sin(dphi/2)**2 + np.cos(p1)*np.cos(p2)*np.sin(dlam/2)**2
    return EARTH_RADIUS_KM * 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1-a))

class TopologyBuilder:
    """Fábrica de Matrices: Traduce el mundo físico a matemática pura."""
    
    def __init__(self, indexer):
        self.indexer = indexer
        self._node_order: List[str] = []
        self._built = False
        # Contenedores de matrices base
        self.A = None
        self.C = None
        self.T = None
        self.K = None
        self.D = None

    def build_topology(self) -> None:
        """Paso 1: Indexar nodos y validar estructura."""
        logger.info("Construyendo topología...")
        self._node_order = list(self.indexer.get_all_node_ids())
        if not self._node_order:
            raise RuntimeError("Error Crítico: El indexer no tiene nodos registrados.")
        self._built = True
        logger.info("Topología finalizada. %d nodos listos.", len(self._node_order))

    def export_matrices(self, sparse: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Paso 2: Generar y exportar la pentada de matrices (A, C, T, K, D)."""
        if not self._built:
            raise RuntimeError("Debe llamar a build_topology() antes de exportar.")

        n = len(self._node_order)
        idx_map = {nid: i for i, nid in enumerate(self._node_order)}
        
        # Estructuras de datos para construcción
        rows, cols = [], []
        d_cost, d_cap = [], []
        lat_u, lon_u, lat_v, lon_v = [], [], [], []
        speeds = []

        # PROCESAMIENTO DE ARCOS
        for arc in self.indexer.iter_arcs():
            if not getattr(arc, "active", True):
                continue
            
            origin = self.indexer.get_node(arc.origin)
            dest = self.indexer.get_node(arc.destination)
            if not origin or not dest:
                continue

            i, j = idx_map[origin.id], idx_map[dest.id]
            rows.append(i)
            cols.append(j)

            # 1. Capacidad (Rigor: Usamos el campo que agregamos al ArcRecord)
            cap_val = getattr(arc, "capacity", 10000.0)
            d_cap.append(float(cap_val) if cap_val is not None else 10000.0)

            # 2. Perfil de Velocidad y Modo
            mode = "truck" # Default
            speed_base = MODE_AVG_SPEED_KMH.get(mode, MODE_AVG_SPEED_KMH["default"])
            speeds.append(speed_base)

            # 3. Coordenadas para Haversine
            lat_u.append(origin.lat)
            lon_u.append(origin.lon)
            lat_v.append(dest.lat)
            lon_v.append(dest.lon)
            
            # 4. Coeficiente de Costo Variable
            var_coef = 1.0
            if hasattr(arc, 'cost_profile') and arc.cost_profile:
                var_coef = getattr(arc.cost_profile, 'variable_coef', 1.0)
            d_cost.append(var_coef)

        # CÁLCULOS VECTORIZADOS (NumPy Power)
        dist = vectorized_haversine(np.array(lat_u), np.array(lon_u), np.array(lat_v), np.array(lon_v))
        final_costs = np.array(d_cost) * dist
        # Evitamos división por cero en tiempo
        final_times = dist / np.where(np.array(speeds) > 0, np.array(speeds), 1.0)

        # CONSTRUCCIÓN DE MATRICES
        A = csr_matrix((np.ones(len(rows)), (rows, cols)), shape=(n, n))
        C = csr_matrix((final_costs, (rows, cols)), shape=(n, n))
        T = csr_matrix((final_times, (rows, cols)), shape=(n, n))
        K = csr_matrix((np.array(d_cap), (rows, cols)), shape=(n, n))

        if not sparse:
            A, C, T, K = A.toarray(), C.toarray(), T.toarray(), K.toarray()

        # VECTOR DE DEMANDA (D)
        vec_d = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
        for i, nid in enumerate(self._node_order):
            node = self.indexer.get_node(nid)
            if node:
                vec_d[i] = float(getattr(node, "demand", 0.0)) - float(getattr(node, "supply", 0.0))

        # METADATOS PARA EL BLOQUE 2
        meta = {
            "base_k_sum": np.sum(K[np.isfinite(K)]),
            "base_a_sum": np.sum(A > 0),
            "units": {"distance": "km", "time": "hours"}
        }

        return {
            "nodes": self._node_order.copy(),
            "A": A, "C": C, "T": T, "K": K, "D": vec_d,
            "meta": meta
        }
```

```py
# src/bloque1/models.py
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Literal, Type, TypeVar, Union, get_origin, get_args
import json
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
T = TypeVar('T', bound='SerializableMixin')

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ErrorDefinition:
    message: str
    severity: Literal['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL']
    suggested_fix: str

ERROR_CATALOG: Dict[str, ErrorDefinition] = {
    "ERR_GEO_001": ErrorDefinition("Coordenadas fuera de rango.", "HIGH", "Validar Lat [-90, 90] y Lon [-180, 180]."),
    "ERR_TIME_001": ErrorDefinition("Cronología inválida.", "HIGH", "Asegurar que start < end."),
    "ERR_COST_001": ErrorDefinition("Perfil de costo inconsistente.", "CRITICAL", "Revisar tramos/parámetros."),
    "ERR_META_001": ErrorDefinition("Metadatos incompletos.", "MEDIUM", "Verificar source y version."),
    "ERR_SPEED_001": ErrorDefinition("Velocidad no positiva.", "HIGH", "Revisar que default > 0."),
    "ERR_ARC_001": ErrorDefinition("Error de topología.", "CRITICAL", "Evitar bucles (origin == destination).")
}

class PrimeLogisticsError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, context_msg: str, error_code: str):
        self.error_code = error_code
        self.definition = ERROR_CATALOG.get(error_code)
        self.severity = self.definition.severity if self.definition else "HIGH"
        self.suggested_fix = self.definition.suggested_fix if self.definition else ""
        msg = f"[{error_code}] {context_msg} -> {self.definition.message if self.definition else ''}"
        super().__init__(msg)

class SerializableMixin:
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        def _serialize(obj):
            if isinstance(obj, dict):
                return {k: _serialize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
            if isinstance(obj, list):
                return [_serialize(i) for i in obj]
            if isinstance(obj, datetime):
                return obj.isoformat()
            return obj
        return _serialize(asdict(self))

    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=indent)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls: Type[T], data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Optional[T]:
        if data is None:
            return None

        annotations = getattr(cls, "__annotations__", {})
        processed: Dict[str, Any] = {}

        for key, value in data.items():
            if key not in annotations or value is None:
                processed[key] = value
                continue

            ftype = annotations[key]
            origin = get_origin(ftype)
            args = get_args(ftype)

            if origin is Union and type(None) in args:
                real_type = next(a for a in args if a is not type(None))
                if hasattr(real_type, "from_dict") and isinstance(value, dict):
                    processed[key] = real_type.from_dict(value)
                else:
                    processed[key] = value
                continue

            if origin is list:
                inner = args[0]
                if hasattr(inner, "from_dict") and isinstance(value, list):
                    processed[key] = [
                        inner.from_dict(i) if isinstance(i, dict) else i for i in value
                    ]
                else:
                    processed[key] = value
                continue

            if hasattr(ftype, "from_dict") and isinstance(value, dict):
                processed[key] = ftype.from_dict(value)
                continue

            if ftype is datetime and isinstance(value, str):
                processed[key] = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                continue

            processed[key] = value

        return cls(**processed)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Metadata(SerializableMixin):
    source: Optional[str] = None
    version: Optional[str] = None
    timestamp: Optional[datetime] = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    extras: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> "Metadata":
        if data is None:
            return cls()
        d = dict(data)
        source = d.pop("source", None)
        version = d.pop("version", None)
        timestamp = d.pop("timestamp", None)
        if isinstance(timestamp, str):
            try:
                timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            except Exception:
                timestamp = None
        extras = d
        return cls(source=source, version=version, timestamp=timestamp, extras=extras)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        if self.source is not None:
            out["source"] = self.source
        if self.version is not None:
            out["version"] = self.version
        if self.timestamp is not None:
            out["timestamp"] = self.timestamp.isoformat()
        for k, v in self.extras.items():
            if k not in out:
                out[k] = v
        return out

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Window(SerializableMixin):
    start: datetime
    end: datetime
    is_recurrent: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.start.tzinfo is None:
            logger.debug("Assuming UTC for naive Window.start")
            object.__setattr__(self, "start", self.start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        if self.end.tzinfo is None:
            logger.debug("Assuming UTC for naive Window.end")
            object.__setattr__(self, "end", self.end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        if self.start >= self.end:
            raise PrimeLogisticsError("start >= end", "ERR_TIME_001")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CostProfile(SerializableMixin):
    cost_type: Literal["flat", "bracket", "curve", "ref"]
    params: Dict[str, Any]

    def __post_init__(self):
        t = self.cost_type
        p = self.params or {}
        if t == "flat":
            if "variable_coef" not in p:
                raise PrimeLogisticsError("flat requires variable_coef", "ERR_COST_001")
            if not isinstance(p["variable_coef"], (int, float)):
                raise PrimeLogisticsError("variable_coef must be numeric", "ERR_COST_001")
        elif t == "bracket":
            tiers = p.get("tiers")
            if not isinstance(tiers, list) or not tiers:
                raise PrimeLogisticsError("bracket requires non-empty tiers", "ERR_COST_001")
            last_max = None
            for i, tier in enumerate(tiers):
                if not all(k in tier for k in ("min", "max", "price")):
                    raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"tier {i} missing keys", "ERR_COST_001")
                if not isinstance(tier["min"], (int, float)) or not isinstance(tier["max"], (int, float)):
                    raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"tier {i} min/max must be numeric", "ERR_COST_001")
                if tier["max"] < tier["min"]:
                    raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"tier {i} max < min", "ERR_COST_001")
                if tier["price"] < 0:
                    raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"tier {i} price < 0", "ERR_COST_001")
                if last_max is not None and tier["min"] != last_max:
                    raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"tier {i} gap/overlap detected", "ERR_COST_001")
                last_max = tier["max"]
        elif t == "curve":
            if "equation" not in p and "func_ref" not in p:
                raise PrimeLogisticsError("curve requires equation or func_ref", "ERR_COST_001")
        elif t == "ref":
            if "tariff_id" not in p:
                raise PrimeLogisticsError("ref requires tariff_id", "ERR_COST_001")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SpeedProfile(SerializableMixin):
    default: float
    conditional: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not isinstance(self.default, (int, float)) or self.default <= 0:
            raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"default speed invalid: {self.default}", "ERR_SPEED_001")
        for k, v in self.conditional.items():
            if not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or v <= 0:
                raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"conditional speed invalid for {k}: {v}", "ERR_SPEED_001")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NodeRecord(SerializableMixin):
    id: str
    lat: float
    lon: float
    supply: float = 0.0
    demand: float = 0.0
    processing_cost: float = 0.0
    priority: int = 0
    metadata: Optional[Metadata] = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not (-90 <= self.lat <= 90) or not (-180 <= self.lon <= 180):
            raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"Coords ({self.lat}, {self.lon})", "ERR_GEO_001")
        if self.processing_cost < 0:
            raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"Costo de nodo negativo: {self.processing_cost}", "ERR_COST_001")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ArcRecord(SerializableMixin):
    id: str
    origin: str
    destination: str
    active: bool = True
    capacity: float = 10000.0
    cost_profile: Optional[CostProfile] = None
    speed_profile: Optional[SpeedProfile] = None
    windows: List[Window] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: Optional[Metadata] = None

    

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.origin == self.destination:
            raise PrimeLogisticsError(f"Bucle en {self.id}", "ERR_ARC_001")

```

```py
Test Suite para el Motor Estocástico

Validación completa del sistema de carga y manejo de incidentes.

import sys
from incidents import (
    ManifestLoader,

def test_basic_loading():
    """Test 1: Carga básica del manifiesto."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("TEST 1: Carga Básica del Manifiesto")
    print("="*80)
    
    try:
        manifest = ManifestLoader.load("manifest.yaml")
        print("✓ Manifiesto cargado exitosamente")
        print(f"✓ Total de eventos: {len(manifest.incidents)}")
        return manifest
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"✗ Error: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


def test_incident_access(manifest):
    """Test 2: Acceso a incidentes por código y categoría."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("TEST 2: Acceso a Incidentes")
    print("="*80)
    
    # Por código
    paro = manifest.get_incident("PARO_NACIONAL_TRANSPORTE")
    if paro:
        print(f"✓ Incidente encontrado: {paro.code}")
        print(f"  - Nivel: {paro.level.value}")
        print(f"  - P_base: {paro.p_base}")
        print(f"  - Target: {paro.target.type.value}")
    else:
        print("✗ No se encontró PARO_NACIONAL_TRANSPORTE")
    
    # Por categoría
    systemic = manifest.get_incidents_by_level(Category.SYSTEMIC)
    tactical = manifest.get_incidents_by_level(Category.TACTICAL)
    micro = manifest.get_incidents_by_level(Category.MICRO)
    
    print("\n✓ Eventos por nivel:")
    print(f"  - SYSTEMIC: {len(systemic)}")
    print(f"  - TACTICAL: {len(tactical)}")
    print(f"  - MICRO: {len(micro)}")


def test_cascade_probability(manifest):
    """Test 3: Cálculo de probabilidad efectiva con cascada."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("TEST 3: Probabilidad Efectiva con Cascada")
    print("="*80)
    
    # Escenario 1: Sin eventos activos
    huelga = manifest.get_incident("HUELGA_ALMACEN")
    if huelga:
        p_normal = huelga.effective_probability([])
        print("\nHUELGA_ALMACEN:")
        print(f"  P_base: {huelga.p_base:.4f}")
        print(f"  P_efectiva (sin cascada): {p_normal:.4f}")
        
        # Escenario 2: Con PARO_NACIONAL_TRANSPORTE activo
        p_cascada = huelga.effective_probability(["PARO_NACIONAL_TRANSPORTE"])
        print(f"  P_efectiva (con PARO activo): {p_cascada:.4f}")
        print(f"  Amplificación: {p_cascada/p_normal:.2f}x")
        
        # Verificar que coincide con el multiplier esperado (8.0)
        expected = min(1.0, huelga.p_base * 8.0)
        assert abs(p_cascada - expected) < 1e-6, "Error en cálculo de cascada"
        print("  ✓ Cálculo de cascada correcto")


def test_impact_calculation(manifest):
    """Test 4: Cálculo de multiplicadores de impacto."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("TEST 4: Cálculo de Impactos en Métricas")
    print("="*80)
    
    crisis = manifest.get_incident("CRISIS_COMBUSTIBLE")
    if crisis:
        global_params = {
            'alpha': manifest.global_parameters.alpha,
            'beta': manifest.global_parameters.beta,
            'gamma': manifest.global_parameters.gamma
        }
        
        print("\nCRISIS_COMBUSTIBLE:")
        print(f"  Parámetros globales: α={global_params['alpha']}, "
              f"β={global_params['beta']}, γ={global_params['gamma']}")
        
        # Calcular impactos
        impact_c = crisis.get_impact_multiplier('C', global_params)
        impact_t = crisis.get_impact_multiplier('T', global_params)
        
        print("\n  Multiplicadores de impacto:")
        print(f"    - Métrica C: {impact_c:.3f}")
        print(f"    - Métrica T: {impact_t:.3f}")
        
        # Verificar manualmente
        # C: base=2.0, scaling=beta=0.35 → 2.0 * (1 + 0.35) = 2.7
        expected_c = 2.0 * (1 + global_params['beta'])
        assert abs(impact_c - expected_c) < 1e-6, "Error en cálculo de impacto C"
        print(f"    ✓ Impacto C verificado: {expected_c:.3f}")

        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)
```

```yaml
meta:
  schema_version: "1.0"
  description: "Manifiesto de eventos de riesgo logístico para Argentina"
  modeling_philosophy: >
    Priors conservadores con sensibilidad calibrada.
    Stress testing y recalibración futura.
    Dependencias evaluadas en orden topológico.
    Impactos combinados multiplicativamente.
  geographic_context: "Argentina"

global_parameters:
  stress_index: baseline
  alpha: 0.15
  beta: 0.35
  gamma: 0.25
  severity_weights_range: [0.5, 2.0]
  outlier_cap:
    type: hard
    max_multiplier: 5.0
```

--- FILE: ./src/bloque2/generator.py ---
```py
import copy
import numpy as np
import random
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from scipy.sparse import issparse

from bloque2.incidents import (
    Manifest, IncidentDefinition, Category, TargetType, AdjacencyAction
)

# ============================================================================
# 1. ESTRUCTURAS DE DATOS (Output y Snapshots)
# ============================================================================

@dataclass
class NetworkSnapshot:
    """Instantánea de la pentada de matrices mutada."""
    A: Any 
    C: Any
    T: Any
    K: Any
    D: Any
    nodes: List[str]
    meta: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    @property
    def n_nodes(self) -> int: 
        return len(self.nodes)

@dataclass
class ScenarioEvent:
    """Metadatos de trazabilidad de la cascada."""
    code: str
    level: str
    p_effective: float
    intensity_multiplier: float
    affected_indices: List[int]

@dataclass
class Scenario:
    """Resultado final de una 'mañana posible'."""
    scenario_id: int
    network: NetworkSnapshot
    events: List[ScenarioEvent]
    stress_index: float
    seed: int

    def get_capacity_reduction(self) -> float:
        """
        Métrica de Resiliencia: Si K es infinito, mide conectividad por arcos (A).
        """
        # 1. Extraemos datos de K (Densa o Sparse)
        k_data = self.network.K.data if issparse(self.network.K) else self.network.K
        current_k = np.sum(k_data[np.isfinite(k_data)])
        
        base_k = self.network.meta.get('base_k_sum', 0.0)
        
        # 2. Si K es infinito o cero, usamos Conectividad Estructural (A) como fallback
        if base_k <= 0 or np.isinf(base_k):
            current_a = np.sum(self.network.A > 0)
            base_a = self.network.meta.get('base_a_sum', current_a)
            return float(current_a / base_a) if base_a > 0 else 0.0
            
        return float(current_k / base_k)

# ============================================================================
# 2. EVALUADOR E INTENSIDAD (Módulo 3)
# ============================================================================

class IntensityEvaluator:
    @staticmethod
    def calcular_multiplicador(base_multiplier: float, S: float, coef: float) -> float:
        """μ_eff = μ_base * (1 + αS). Cap de 5x."""
        impacto = 1 + ((base_multiplier - 1) * (1 + coef * S))
        return min(impacto, 5.0)

# ============================================================================
# 3. ACTOR: MUTADOR MATRICIAL (Módulo 4)
# ============================================================================

class NetworkActor:
    @staticmethod
    def apply_incident(net: NetworkSnapshot, incident: IncidentDefinition, indices: List[int], S: float, params: Any) -> float:
        m = 1.0
        
        # 1. Kill-switch (A y K)
        if incident.structural_effects.adjacency.action == AdjacencyAction.DISABLE:
            if issparse(net.A):
                net.A = net.A.tolil()
                net.K = net.K.tolil()
            
            for idx in indices:
                net.A[idx, :], net.A[:, idx] = 0, 0
                net.K[idx, :], net.K[:, idx] = 0, 0
            
            if not isinstance(net.A, np.ndarray):
                net.A = net.A.tocsr()
                net.K = net.K.tocsr()

        # 2. Capacidad (Solo si es Sistémico)
        if incident.level == Category.SYSTEMIC and incident.structural_effects.capacity.modifier != 1.0:
            for idx in indices:
                if issparse(net.K):
                    net.K.data[net.K.indptr[idx]:net.K.indptr[idx+1]] *= incident.structural_effects.capacity.modifier
                else:
                    net.K[idx, :] *= incident.structural_effects.capacity.modifier

        # 3. Métricas (C, T, D)
        for impact in incident.metric_impacts:
            coef = params.alpha if impact.metric == 'T' else params.gamma
            m = IntensityEvaluator.calcular_multiplicador(impact.base_multiplier, S, coef)
            
            target_matrix = getattr(net, impact.metric)
            for idx in indices:
                if issparse(target_matrix):
                    target_matrix.data[target_matrix.indptr[idx]:target_matrix.indptr[idx+1]] *= m
                else:
                    target_matrix[idx, :] *= m
        return m

# ============================================================================
# 4. GENERADOR Y ENGINE (Módulo 2 y 5)
# ============================================================================

class MonteCarloGenerator:
    def __init__(self, base_network: NetworkSnapshot, manifest: Manifest, seed: Optional[int] = None):
        self.base_network = base_network
        self.manifest = manifest
        self.seed = seed

    def _generate_single_scenario(self, scenario_id: int) -> Scenario:
        net = copy.deepcopy(self.base_network)
        active_codes, events, S = set(), [], 0.0
        
        for level in [Category.SYSTEMIC, Category.TACTICAL, Category.MICRO]:
            for inc in self.manifest.get_incidents_by_level(level):
                p_eff = inc.effective_probability(list(active_codes))
                if random.random() < p_eff:
                    active_codes.add(inc.code)
                    S += inc.stress_weight
                    indices = self._get_target_indices(net, inc)
                    m = NetworkActor.apply_incident(net, inc, indices, S, self.manifest.global_parameters)
                    events.append(ScenarioEvent(inc.code, level.value, p_eff, m, indices))
                    
        return Scenario(scenario_id, net, events, S, (self.seed or 0) + scenario_id)

    def _get_target_indices(self, net: NetworkSnapshot, inc: IncidentDefinition) -> List[int]:
        sel = inc.target.selector
        if inc.target.type == TargetType.NETWORK:
            return list(range(net.n_nodes))
        return [i for i, node in enumerate(net.nodes) if node == sel or (sel.endswith("*") and node.startswith(sel[:-1]))]

class MonteCarloEngine:
    def __init__(self, generator: MonteCarloGenerator):
        self.generator = generator

    def run(self, e_limit=0.01, window=50, max_iter=500):
        history, results = [], []
        for i in range(1, max_iter + 1):
            s = self.generator._generate_single_scenario(i)
            results.append(s)
            history.append(s.get_capacity_reduction())
            
            if i >= window * 2 and i % window == 0:
                if self._ha_convergido(history, window, e_limit):
                    print(f"✓ Convergencia alcanzada en {i} iteraciones.")
                    break
        return results

    def _ha_convergido(self, h, w, eps):
        prev, curr = h[-w*2 : -w], h[-w:]
        return abs(np.mean(curr) - np.mean(prev)) < eps and abs(np.var(curr) - np.var(prev)) < eps

# ============================================================================
# 5. ADAPTERS Y ANALYZER
# ============================================================================

def load_base_network_from_bloque1(topology_package: Dict[str, Any]) -> NetworkSnapshot:
    K_base = topology_package['K']
    A_base = topology_package['A']
    
    def sum_finite(m):
        data = m.data if issparse(m) else m
        finitos = data[np.isfinite(data)]
        return np.sum(finitos) if finitos.size > 0 else 0.0

    meta = topology_package.get('meta', {}).copy()
    meta['base_k_sum'] = sum_finite(K_base)
    meta['base_a_sum'] = np.sum(A_base > 0)

    return NetworkSnapshot(
        A=A_base, C=topology_package['C'], T=topology_package['T'],
        K=K_base, D=topology_package['D'], nodes=topology_package['nodes'], meta=meta
    )

class ScenarioAnalyzer:
    @staticmethod
    def compute_statistics(scenarios: List[Scenario]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        ret = [s.get_capacity_reduction() for s in scenarios]
        avg = np.mean(ret)
        return {
            'n_scenarios': len(scenarios),
            'scenarios_with_events': sum(1 for s in scenarios if s.events),
            'avg_capacity_retention': avg,
            'avg_capacity_loss': 1.0 - avg
        }

    @staticmethod
    def get_worst_case_scenario(scenarios: List[Scenario]) -> Scenario:
        return min(scenarios, key=lambda s: s.get_capacity_reduction())
```


--- FILE: ./src/bloque2/example_advanced.py ---
```py
"""
Ejemplo Avanzado: Análisis de Escenarios de Riesgo
===================================================

Demuestra casos de uso realistas del motor estocástico para:
1. Análisis de sensibilidad a parámetros globales
2. Simulación de cascadas de eventos
3. Cálculo de impactos agregados
4. Generación de reportes de riesgo
"""

from incidents import ManifestLoader, Category
from typing import List, Dict
import random


class RiskAnalyzer:
    """Analizador de riesgo logístico basado en el manifiesto."""
    
    def __init__(self, manifest_path: str = "manifest.yaml"):
        """Inicializa el analizador cargando el manifiesto."""
        self.manifest = ManifestLoader.load(manifest_path)
        self.global_params = {
            'alpha': self.manifest.global_parameters.alpha,
            'beta': self.manifest.global_parameters.beta,
            'gamma': self.manifest.global_parameters.gamma
        }
    
    def simulate_single_day(self, seed: int = None) -> Dict:
        """
        Simula un día individual con eventos estocásticos.
        
        Args:
            seed: Semilla para reproducibilidad
            
        Returns:
            Diccionario con eventos ocurridos y sus efectos
        """
        if seed is not None:
            random.seed(seed)
        
        active_events = []
        effects = {
            'capacity_reduction': 1.0,
            'demand_increase': 1.0,
            'disabled_connections': 0,
            'affected_nodes': [],
            'affected_arcs': []
        }
        
        # Procesar eventos en orden topológico (SYSTEMIC → TACTICAL → MICRO)
        for level in [Category.SYSTEMIC, Category.TACTICAL, Category.MICRO]:
            incidents = self.manifest.get_incidents_by_level(level)
            
            for incident in incidents:
                # Calcular probabilidad efectiva con cascada
                p_eff = incident.effective_probability(
                    [evt['code'] for evt in active_events]
                )
                
                # Lanzar dado
                if random.random() < p_eff:
                    # Evento ocurre
                    event_data = {
                        'code': incident.code,
                        'level': incident.level.value,
                        'p_base': incident.p_base,
                        'p_effective': p_eff,
                        'amplification': p_eff / incident.p_base if incident.p_base > 0 else 1.0
                    }
                    active_events.append(event_data)
                    
                    # Aplicar efectos estructurales
                    effects['capacity_reduction'] *= incident.structural_effects.capacity.modifier
                    effects['demand_increase'] *= incident.structural_effects.demand.modifier
                    
                    if incident.structural_effects.adjacency.action.value == 'DISABLE':
                        effects['disabled_connections'] += 1
                    
                    # Registrar elementos afectados
                    if incident.target.type.value in ['NODE', 'ZONE']:
                        effects['affected_nodes'].append(incident.target.selector)
                    elif incident.target.type.value == 'ARC':
                        effects['affected_arcs'].append(incident.target.selector)
        
        return {
            'events': active_events,
            'effects': effects,
            'total_events': len(active_events)
        }
    
    def monte_carlo_analysis(self, n_scenarios: int = 1000, seed: int = 42) -> Dict:
        """
        Ejecuta análisis Monte Carlo de N escenarios.
        
        Args:
            n_scenarios: Número de escenarios a simular
            seed: Semilla inicial
            
        Returns:
            Estadísticas agregadas de los escenarios
        """
        random.seed(seed)
        
        results = {
            'event_frequencies': {},
            'cascade_activations': 0,
            'capacity_reductions': [],
            'demand_increases': [],
            'scenarios_with_events': 0
        }
        
        # Inicializar contadores de frecuencia
        for incident in self.manifest.incidents:
            results['event_frequencies'][incident.code] = 0
        
        # Ejecutar simulaciones
        for i in range(n_scenarios):
            scenario = self.simulate_single_day(seed=seed + i)
            
            if scenario['total_events'] > 0:
                results['scenarios_with_events'] += 1
            
            # Contar eventos
            for event in scenario['events']:
                results['event_frequencies'][event['code']] += 1
                
                # Detectar cascadas (amplificación > 1)
                if event['amplification'] > 1.1:
                    results['cascade_activations'] += 1
            
            # Acumular efectos
            results['capacity_reductions'].append(scenario['effects']['capacity_reduction'])
            results['demand_increases'].append(scenario['effects']['demand_increase'])
        
        # Calcular estadísticas
        results['event_probabilities'] = {
            code: freq / n_scenarios 
            for code, freq in results['event_frequencies'].items()
        }
        
        results['avg_capacity_reduction'] = sum(results['capacity_reductions']) / n_scenarios
        results['avg_demand_increase'] = sum(results['demand_increases']) / n_scenarios
        results['cascade_rate'] = results['cascade_activations'] / max(1, results['scenarios_with_events'])
        
        return results
    
    def sensitivity_analysis(self, parameter: str, values: List[float]) -> Dict:
        """
        Analiza sensibilidad de impactos a parámetros globales.
        
        Args:
            parameter: Nombre del parámetro (alpha, beta, gamma)
            values: Lista de valores a probar
            
        Returns:
            Resultados de sensibilidad
        """
        original_value = self.global_params[parameter]
        sensitivity = {}
        
        for val in values:
            # Modificar parámetro temporalmente
            self.global_params[parameter] = val
            
            # Calcular impactos promedio
            total_impact_c = 0
            total_impact_t = 0
            count = 0
            
            for incident in self.manifest.incidents:
                impact_c = incident.get_impact_multiplier('C', self.global_params)
                impact_t = incident.get_impact_multiplier('T', self.global_params)
                
                if impact_c > 1.0:
                    total_impact_c += impact_c
                    count += 1
                if impact_t > 1.0:
                    total_impact_t += impact_t
            
            sensitivity[val] = {
                'avg_impact_c': total_impact_c / count if count > 0 else 1.0,
                'avg_impact_t': total_impact_t / len(self.manifest.incidents)
            }
        
        # Restaurar valor original
        self.global_params[parameter] = original_value
        
        return sensitivity
    
    def generate_risk_report(self, n_scenarios: int = 1000) -> str:
        """
        Genera reporte de riesgo legible.
        
        Args:
            n_scenarios: Número de escenarios para Monte Carlo
            
        Returns:
            Reporte en formato texto
        """
        mc_results = self.monte_carlo_analysis(n_scenarios)
        
        report = []
        report.append("=" * 80)
        report.append("REPORTE DE ANÁLISIS DE RIESGO LOGÍSTICO")
        report.append("=" * 80)
        report.append(f"\nSimulación Monte Carlo: {n_scenarios:,} escenarios")
        report.append(f"Escenarios con al menos un evento: {mc_results['scenarios_with_events']:,} "
                     f"({mc_results['scenarios_with_events']/n_scenarios*100:.1f}%)")
        
        # Top 5 eventos más frecuentes
        report.append("\n" + "-" * 80)
        report.append("TOP 5 EVENTOS MÁS FRECUENTES")
        report.append("-" * 80)
        
        sorted_events = sorted(
            mc_results['event_probabilities'].items(),
            key=lambda x: x[1],
            reverse=True
        )[:5]
        
        for i, (code, prob) in enumerate(sorted_events, 1):
            incident = self.manifest.get_incident(code)
            report.append(f"{i}. {code}")
            report.append(f"   Nivel: {incident.level.value}")
            report.append(f"   P_base: {incident.p_base:.4f}")
            report.append(f"   P_observada: {prob:.4f}")
            report.append(f"   Frecuencia: {mc_results['event_frequencies'][code]} ocurrencias")
            report.append("")
        
        # Impacto promedio
        report.append("-" * 80)
        report.append("IMPACTOS PROMEDIO EN LA RED")
        report.append("-" * 80)
        report.append(f"Reducción de capacidad: {(1 - mc_results['avg_capacity_reduction']) * 100:.2f}%")
        report.append(f"Aumento de demanda: {(mc_results['avg_demand_increase'] - 1) * 100:.2f}%")
        report.append(f"Tasa de cascadas: {mc_results['cascade_rate']:.2f} cascadas/escenario con eventos")
        
        # Eventos con condicionadores activos
        report.append("\n" + "-" * 80)
        report.append("DEPENDENCIAS DE CASCADA")
        report.append("-" * 80)
        
        for incident in self.manifest.incidents:
            if incident.conditioners:
                report.append(f"\n{incident.code}:")
                for cond in incident.conditioners:
                    report.append(f"  → Amplifica {cond.multiplier:.1f}x cuando ocurre {cond.event}")
        
        report.append("\n" + "=" * 80)
        
        return "\n".join(report)


def example_1_basic_simulation():
    """Ejemplo 1: Simulación básica de un día."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("EJEMPLO 1: Simulación de un Día Individual")
    print("="*80)
    
    analyzer = RiskAnalyzer()
    
    # Simular 3 días diferentes
    for day in range(1, 4):
        print(f"\n--- Día {day} ---")
        scenario = analyzer.simulate_single_day(seed=day)
        
        if scenario['total_events'] == 0:
            print("Sin eventos disruptivos")
        else:
            print(f"Eventos ocurridos: {scenario['total_events']}")
            for event in scenario['events']:
                amp_str = f" (x{event['amplification']:.1f})" if event['amplification'] > 1.1 else ""
                print(f"  - {event['code']}: P_eff={event['p_effective']:.4f}{amp_str}")
            
            effects = scenario['effects']
            print("\nEfectos agregados:")
            print(f"  Capacidad residual: {effects['capacity_reduction'] * 100:.1f}%")
            print(f"  Demanda ajustada: {effects['demand_increase'] * 100:.1f}%")


def example_2_monte_carlo():
    """Ejemplo 2: Análisis Monte Carlo."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("EJEMPLO 2: Análisis Monte Carlo (1000 escenarios)")
    print("="*80)
    
    analyzer = RiskAnalyzer()
    results = analyzer.monte_carlo_analysis(n_scenarios=1000)
    
    print(f"\nEscenarios con eventos: {results['scenarios_with_events']}/1000")
    print(f"Tasa de cascadas: {results['cascade_rate']:.2f}")
    
    # Top 3 eventos
    print("\nTop 3 eventos más frecuentes:")
    sorted_events = sorted(
        results['event_probabilities'].items(),
        key=lambda x: x[1],
        reverse=True
    )[:3]
    
    for code, prob in sorted_events:
        print(f"  {code}: {prob:.4f} (esperado: {analyzer.manifest.get_incident(code).p_base:.4f})")


def example_3_sensitivity():
    """Ejemplo 3: Análisis de sensibilidad."""
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("EJEMPLO 3: Análisis de Sensibilidad a Parámetro γ (gamma)")
    print("="*80)
    
    analyzer = RiskAnalyzer()
    
    # Probar diferentes valores de gamma
    gamma_values = [0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0]
    sensitivity = analyzer.sensitivity_analysis('gamma', gamma_values)
    
    print("\nImpacto de γ en multiplicadores de tiempo:")
    for gamma, impacts in sensitivity.items():
        print(f"  γ={gamma:.2f}: Impacto promedio en T = {impacts['avg_impact_t']:.3f}")

    """Ejemplo 4: Reporte completo de riesgo."""
```

--- FILE: ./src/bloque2/incidents.py ---
```py
"""
Stochastic Engine - Incident Definition Module
================================================

Este módulo proporciona las estructuras de datos y cargadores para el manifiesto
de eventos de riesgo logístico. Diseñado para ser extensible: agregar nuevos eventos
al YAML no requiere cambios en este código.

Arquitectura:
    - Enums tipados para categorías, tipos de distribución y objetivos
    - Dataclasses para mapear la estructura del YAML
    - Validación automática en __post_init__
    - Cargador centralizado con manejo de errores

Uso:
    >>> manifest = ManifestLoader.load("manifest.yaml")
    >>> for incident in manifest.incidents:
    ...     print(f"{incident.code}: P={incident.p_base}")
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
import yaml
import os

# ============================================================================
# ENUMERACIONES TIPADAS
# ============================================================================

class Category(Enum):
    """Categoría jerárquica del evento de riesgo."""
    SYSTEMIC = "SYSTEMIC"    # Alcance nacional/regional
    TACTICAL = "TACTICAL"    # Alcance zonal/sectorial
    MICRO = "MICRO"          # Operativo/cotidiano


class DistType(Enum):
    """Tipo de distribución probabilística para el evento."""
    EVT = "EVT"              # Extreme Value Theory
    LOGNORMAL = "LOGNORMAL"  # Log-normal
    POISSON = "POISSON"      # Poisson
    UNIFORM = "UNIFORM"      # Uniforme


class TargetType(Enum):
    """Tipo de elemento de la red afectado por el evento."""
    NETWORK = "NETWORK"      # Red completa
    ZONE = "ZONE"            # Zona geográfica
    ARC = "ARC"              # Arco/conexión
    NODE = "NODE"            # Nodo/instalación
    UNIT = "UNIT"            # Unidad/vehículo


class AdjacencyAction(Enum):
    """Acción sobre la adyacencia/conectividad del elemento."""
    NONE = "NONE"            # Sin cambio
    DISABLE = "DISABLE"      # Deshabilitar completamente
    PARTIAL = "PARTIAL"      # Afectación parcial


class ConditionerScope(Enum):
    """Ámbito de aplicación del condicionador de cascada."""
    PROBABILITY = "probability"  # Modifica probabilidad
    IMPACT = "impact"            # Modifica impacto


# ============================================================================
# DATACLASSES - ESTRUCTURAS ANIDADAS
# ============================================================================

@dataclass
class Distribution:
    """Especificación de distribución probabilística."""
    type: DistType
    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Valida que el tipo sea un DistType válido."""
        if isinstance(self.type, str):
            self.type = DistType[self.type]


@dataclass
class Target:
    """Especificación del objetivo del evento."""
    type: TargetType
    selector: str  # Patrón para seleccionar elementos (e.g., "WAREHOUSE_*")
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Convierte string a TargetType si es necesario."""
        if isinstance(self.type, str):
            self.type = TargetType[self.type]


@dataclass
class AdjacencyEffect:
    """Efecto sobre la adyacencia/conectividad."""
    action: AdjacencyAction
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Convierte string a AdjacencyAction si es necesario."""
        if isinstance(self.action, str):
            self.action = AdjacencyAction[self.action]


@dataclass
class CapacityEffect:
    """Efecto sobre la capacidad del elemento."""
    modifier: float  # Multiplicador: 1.0 = sin cambio, 0.0 = anulado, >1.0 = incremento
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Valida que el modificador sea no-negativo."""
        if self.modifier < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"Capacity modifier debe ser >= 0, obtenido: {self.modifier}")


@dataclass
class DemandEffect:
    """Efecto sobre la demanda del elemento."""
    modifier: float  # Multiplicador de demanda
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Valida que el modificador sea no-negativo."""
        if self.modifier < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"Demand modifier debe ser >= 0, obtenido: {self.modifier}")


@dataclass
class StructuralEffects:
    """Conjunto de efectos estructurales sobre la red."""
    adjacency: AdjacencyEffect
    capacity: CapacityEffect
    demand: DemandEffect


@dataclass
class MetricImpact:
    """Impacto sobre una métrica específica (C, T, etc.)."""
    metric: str  # Código de métrica (e.g., "T", "C")
    base_multiplier: float
    stress_scaling: str  # Parámetro global a usar (alpha, beta, gamma)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Valida que el multiplicador base sea positivo."""
        if self.base_multiplier <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"base_multiplier debe ser > 0, obtenido: {self.base_multiplier}")


@dataclass
class Conditioner:
    """
    Condicionador de cascada: especifica cómo un evento previo afecta a este.
    
    La probabilidad efectiva se calculará como:
        P_eff = min(1, P_base * ∏ φ_k)
    donde φ_k es el multiplier de cada conditioner activo.
    """
    event: str  # Código del evento condicionante
    multiplier: float  # Factor multiplicativo
    scope: ConditionerScope  # Ámbito de aplicación
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """Valida el condicionador."""
        if isinstance(self.scope, str):
            self.scope = ConditionerScope[self.scope.upper()]
        if self.multiplier < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"Conditioner multiplier debe ser >= 0, obtenido: {self.multiplier}")


# ============================================================================
# DATACLASS PRINCIPAL - DEFINICIÓN DE INCIDENTE
# ============================================================================

@dataclass
class IncidentDefinition:
    """
    Definición completa de un evento de riesgo logístico.
    
    Mapea directamente la estructura del YAML y proporciona validación
    automática de parámetros críticos.
    """
    code: str  # Identificador único del evento
    level: Category  # Categoría jerárquica
    description: str  # Descripción legible
    p_base: float  # Probabilidad base [0, 1]
    distribution: Distribution  # Especificación de distribución
    stress_weight: float  # Peso para stress testing
    conditioners: List[Conditioner]  # Lista de dependencias de cascada
    target: Target  # Especificación del objetivo
    structural_effects: StructuralEffects  # Efectos sobre estructura
    metric_impacts: List[MetricImpact]  # Impactos en métricas
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        """
        Validación post-inicialización.
        
        Verifica:
            - p_base ∈ [0, 1]
            - level es un Category válido
            - Tipos anidados están correctamente instanciados
        """
        # Validar probabilidad base
        if not 0 <= self.p_base <= 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Probabilidad base para {self.code} fuera de rango [0,1]: {self.p_base}"
            )
        
        # Convertir level si viene como string
        if isinstance(self.level, str):
            try:
                self.level = Category[self.level]
            except KeyError:
                raise ValueError(f"Categoría inválida para {self.code}: {self.level}")
        
        # Validar stress_weight
        if self.stress_weight < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"stress_weight debe ser >= 0 para {self.code}")
    
    def effective_probability(self, active_events: List[str]) -> float:
        """Cálculo de cascada: P_eff = min(1, P_base * ∏ φ_k)"""
        p_eff = self.p_base
        for cond in self.conditioners:
            if cond.scope == ConditionerScope.PROBABILITY and cond.event in active_events:
                p_eff *= cond.multiplier
        return min(1.0, p_eff)
    
    def get_impact_multiplier(self, metric: str, stress_index: float, global_params: Dict[str, float]) -> float:
        """
        CÁLCULO DINÁMICO: Aplica la sensibilidad al Stress Index real.
        Fórmula Prime: Multiplier = Base * (1 + Sensibilidad * S)
        """
        for impact in self.metric_impacts:
            if impact.metric == metric:
                sensitivity = global_params.get(impact.stress_scaling, 0.0)
                # Aquí inyectamos el Stress Index (S) de la iteración
                return impact.base_multiplier * (1 + (sensitivity * stress_index))
        return 1.0


# ============================================================================
# PARÁMETROS GLOBALES
# ============================================================================

@dataclass
class OutlierCap:
    """Configuración de límites para valores atípicos."""
    type: str  # "hard" o "soft"
    max_multiplier: float


@dataclass
class Convergence:
    """Parámetros de convergencia para simulaciones."""
    window_iterations: int
    epsilon: float


@dataclass
class GlobalParameters:
    """Parámetros globales del manifiesto."""
    stress_index: str
    alpha: float
    beta: float
    gamma: float
    severity_weights_range: List[float]
    outlier_cap: OutlierCap
    convergence: Convergence
    impact_combination_rules: List[str]


# ============================================================================
# MANIFIESTO COMPLETO
# ============================================================================

@dataclass
class Manifest:
    """Manifiesto completo cargado desde YAML."""
    meta: Dict[str, Any]
    global_parameters: GlobalParameters
    event_levels: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]
    incidents: List[IncidentDefinition]
    
    def get_incident(self, code: str) -> Optional[IncidentDefinition]:
        """Busca un incidente por su código."""
        for incident in self.incidents:
            if incident.code == code:
                return incident
        return None
    
    def get_incidents_by_level(self, level: Category) -> List[IncidentDefinition]:
        """Retorna todos los incidentes de un nivel dado."""
        return [inc for inc in self.incidents if inc.level == level]


# ============================================================================
# CARGADOR DE MANIFIESTO
# ============================================================================

class ManifestLoader:
    """
    Cargador centralizado del manifiesto YAML.
    
    Responsabilidades:
        - Parsear YAML
        - Instanciar dataclasses
        - Validar estructura
        - Manejo de errores
    """
    
   
    @staticmethod
    def load(filename: str = "manifest.yaml") -> 'Manifest':
        # RECUPERAMOS EL BLINDAJE DE RUTA (Esencial para que no falle el test)
        base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
        full_path = os.path.join(base_dir, filename)
        
        try:
            with open(full_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                data = yaml.safe_load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Error: No se encontró el manifiesto en {full_path}")
        
        # Extraer secciones
        meta = data.get('meta', {})
        global_params_raw = data.get('global_parameters', {})
        event_levels = data.get('event_levels', {})
        events_raw = data.get('events', [])
        
        # Parsear global_parameters
        global_params = ManifestLoader._parse_global_parameters(global_params_raw)
        
        # Parsear incidents
        incidents = ManifestLoader._parse_incidents(events_raw)
        
        return Manifest(
            meta=meta,
            global_parameters=global_params,
            event_levels=event_levels,
            incidents=incidents
        )
    
    @staticmethod
    def _parse_global_parameters(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> GlobalParameters:
        """Parsea la sección global_parameters."""
        outlier_cap = OutlierCap(
            type=data['outlier_cap']['type'],
            max_multiplier=data['outlier_cap']['max_multiplier']
        )
        
        convergence = Convergence(
            window_iterations=data['convergence']['window_iterations'],
            epsilon=data['convergence']['epsilon']
        )
        
        return GlobalParameters(
            stress_index=data['stress_index'],
            alpha=data['alpha'],
            beta=data['beta'],
            gamma=data['gamma'],
            severity_weights_range=data['severity_weights_range'],
            outlier_cap=outlier_cap,
            convergence=convergence,
            impact_combination_rules=data['impact_combination_rules']
        )
    
    @staticmethod
    def _parse_incidents(events_list: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[IncidentDefinition]:
        """Parsea la lista de eventos en IncidentDefinitions."""
        incidents = []
        
        for event_data in events_list:
            # Parsear estructuras anidadas
            distribution = Distribution(**event_data['distribution'])
            target = Target(**event_data['target'])
            
            # Parsear structural_effects
            adjacency = AdjacencyEffect(**event_data['structural_effects']['adjacency'])
            capacity = CapacityEffect(**event_data['structural_effects']['capacity'])
            demand = DemandEffect(**event_data['structural_effects']['demand'])
            structural_effects = StructuralEffects(
                adjacency=adjacency,
                capacity=capacity,
                demand=demand
            )
            
            # Parsear metric_impacts
            metric_impacts = [MetricImpact(**mi) for mi in event_data['metric_impacts']]
            
            # Parsear conditioners
            conditioners = [Conditioner(**c) for c in event_data['conditioners']]
            
            # Crear IncidentDefinition
            incident = IncidentDefinition(
                code=event_data['code'],
                level=event_data['level'],
                description=event_data['description'],
                p_base=event_data['p_base'],
                distribution=distribution,
                stress_weight=event_data['stress_weight'],
                conditioners=conditioners,
                target=target,
                structural_effects=structural_effects,
                metric_impacts=metric_impacts
            )
            
            incidents.append(incident)
        
        return incidents


# ============================================================================
# UTILIDADES Y HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def print_manifest_summary(manifest: Manifest) -> None:
    """Imprime un resumen del manifiesto cargado."""
    print("=" * 80)
    print("MANIFIESTO DE EVENTOS DE RIESGO LOGÍSTICO")
    print("=" * 80)
    print(f"Versión Schema: {manifest.meta.get('schema_version')}")
    print(f"Contexto: {manifest.meta.get('geographic_context')}")
    print(f"\nTotal de eventos: {len(manifest.incidents)}")
    
    # Resumen por categoría
    for category in Category:
        incidents = manifest.get_incidents_by_level(category)
        print(f"  - {category.value}: {len(incidents)} eventos")
    
    # Parámetros globales
    print("\nParámetros Globales:")
    print(f"  - Stress Index: {manifest.global_parameters.stress_index}")
    print(f"  - Alpha: {manifest.global_parameters.alpha}")
    print(f"  - Beta: {manifest.global_parameters.beta}")
    print(f"  - Gamma: {manifest.global_parameters.gamma}")
    
    print("=" * 80)


def validate_manifest_integrity(manifest: Manifest) -> List[str]:
    """
    Valida la integridad del manifiesto cargado.
    
    Verifica:
        - Referencias de conditioners son válidas
        - No hay ciclos en dependencias
        - Target types son consistentes con event levels
        
    Returns:
        Lista de advertencias (vacía si todo OK)
    """
    warnings = []
    event_codes = {inc.code for inc in manifest.incidents}
    
    # Verificar referencias de conditioners
    for incident in manifest.incidents:
        for cond in incident.conditioners:
            if cond.event not in event_codes:
                warnings.append(
                    f"WARNING: {incident.code} referencia evento inexistente: {cond.event}"
                )
    
    # Verificar consistencia de target types con event levels
    level_rules = manifest.event_levels
    for incident in manifest.incidents:
        allowed = level_rules[incident.level.value].get('allowed_target_types', [])
        if incident.target.type.value not in allowed:
            warnings.append(
                f"WARNING: {incident.code} usa target {incident.target.type.value} "
                f"no permitido para nivel {incident.level.value}"
            )
    
    return warnings


# ============================================================================
# EJEMPLO DE USO
# ============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Cargar manifiesto
    manifest = ManifestLoader.load("manifest.yaml")
    
    # Mostrar resumen
    print_manifest_summary(manifest)
    
    # Validar integridad
    warnings = validate_manifest_integrity(manifest)
    if warnings:
        print("\nADVERTENCIAS:")
        for w in warnings:
            print(f"  {w}")
    else:
        print("\n✓ Manifiesto validado correctamente")
    
    # Ejemplo: Calcular probabilidad efectiva con cascada
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("EJEMPLO: Cálculo de Probabilidad Efectiva con Cascada")
    print("=" * 80)
    
    # Simular que INUNDACION_REGIONAL está activo
    active_events = ["INUNDACION_REGIONAL"]
    
    # Buscar evento que depende de INUNDACION_REGIONAL
    bloqueo = manifest.get_incident("BLOQUEO_RUTA")
    if bloqueo:
        p_base = bloqueo.p_base
        p_eff = bloqueo.effective_probability(active_events)
        print(f"\nEvento: {bloqueo.code}")
        print(f"  P_base: {p_base:.4f}")
        print(f"  P_efectiva (con INUNDACION_REGIONAL activo): {p_eff:.4f}")
        print(f"  Factor de amplificación: {p_eff/p_base:.2f}x")
    
    # Mostrar detalles de un evento SYSTEMIC
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("EJEMPLO: Detalles de Evento SYSTEMIC")
    print("=" * 80)
    
    crisis = manifest.get_incident("CRISIS_COMBUSTIBLE")
    if crisis:
        print(f"\n{crisis.code}:")
        print(f"  Nivel: {crisis.level.value}")
        print(f"  P_base: {crisis.p_base}")
        print(f"  Target: {crisis.target.type.value} ({crisis.target.selector})")
        print(f"  Capacidad reducida a: {crisis.structural_effects.capacity.modifier * 100}%")
        print("  Impactos en métricas:")
        for impact in crisis.metric_impacts:
            print(f"    - {impact.metric}: x{impact.base_multiplier} (escala: {impact.stress_scaling})")
```
